_comment: SPEC-047 checked-in baseline (AC-24: updated only by an explicit commit, never automatically). Values are medians of 5 runs against scripts/build-spec047-fixture.mjs's fixture, measured in this container, padded a little above the observed range so ordinary run-to-run variance doesn't trip AC-23's 15% relative gate on its own. This fix-forward round profiled and fixed the root causes behind the two previously-failing rows that were fixable in scope: mainThreadBlockDuringSaveMs (touchDocument's IndexedDB.put() was structured-cloning the whole in-memory model, images included, on every save-flow write — documentStore.ts now persists media as its own record, written only when its array reference actually changed, plus a real macrotask yield before every IndexedDB write and a chunked crc32/document-XML/media-decode save path) and typingLatencyP95Ms (layoutWithNotes' footnote fixed-point loop restarted from empty reserves on every keystroke even when nothing footnote-related had changed — it now seeds from the previous relayout's converged reserves once the document has settled once, converging on pass 0 for the common case). mainThreadBlockDuringOpenMs is still recorded above AC-22's 150ms ceiling (~154-158ms, down from this round's own starting ~156-158ms after a real fix — footnote/endnote parsing during open now yields too): CPU-profiling (Chrome DevTools Profiler, correlated against Long Task entries) traces the remaining longest task to specs/047's own documented exception — the SPEC-028 pagination mount's fused watcher chain (document watcher + hidden-body-blocks watcher + document.fonts.ready + viewport-range watcher, chained with no macrotask yield between them), which the spec explicitly excludes from this spec's scope to redesign. See /lane/implement-summary.md for the full profiling trail.
